panels.description: Sitara holds a field tablet over selected physical records while her TJ scans the pages. Frost shakes loose; Nayah watches the exit. Leave upper-left for a small machinery sound and upper-right for Nayah's dialogue.

The tablet displays an overlay linking drilling trace and ice-motion plot, showing local acceleration without implying Falcon caused the whole Antarctic crisis. Leave lower area for Sitara's dialogue.
Meltwater beads along the threshold as Nayah pulls the emergency line taut. Sitara closes the tablet. Leave upper third for Nayah's dialogue.
The copied record shows the Nexus route and paired-timestamp instruction. Keep the tablet legible and leave the center and bottom for two captions.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Then the copy has to be complete.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Local acceleration. Not the whole system.
